name: rehearse
description: Splits a job into stages and has each one done by hand against the real target before any code: a worker looks and registers the stage's ending, you confirm it in plain words, a worker builds until it passes, and an independent director checks every stage and the whole job. Turn it on by starting a prompt with 'rehearse'.

mode.title: Default mode
mode.description: ask (default): you confirm the goal, the plan and each ending. auto: the goal, the plan and the job ending are confirmed up front, then nothing is asked; later endings and judgment calls are accepted as registered and listed as chosen on your behalf. A mode word right after `rehearse` overrides this for one job.

loop_breaker_rounds.title: Loop breaker rounds
loop_breaker_rounds.description: Failing runs in a row before edits lock again.

director_model.title: Director model
director_model.description: The model the director runs on.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: The model the reviewer (fresh eyes on a stopped worker's log) runs on; the director's by default.

websearch.title: WebSearch available
websearch.description: Whether the WebSearch tool is available in this environment. A tried route or a review must cite a logged WebSearch; only when this is off may a record carry --no-websearch '<reason>' instead.

worker_model.title: Worker model
worker_model.description: The model the look and build workers run on.
